Hi Nora — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice.

I want to be pragmatic here. A couple quick clarifying points before I pull legal in:
1) Is 12/15 the firm end date or the target?
2) Are you asking that Redwood waive any contractually required notice window (the Order Form has 60-day automatic renewal/notice language) so ACME can terminate without penalty?
3) Do you need data/keys wiped or a formal offboarding checklist? We can do a locked-down handoff and produce a short runbook.

From experience, legal is usually OK with a mutual shorter notice (e.g., 30–45 days) and a pro-rata credit for unused, prepaid months rather than a full refund. If that works for you, I can loop in Kimberly and Ben to draft a quick mutual amendment and a redline for the Order Form.

If you want us to waive the auto-renew entirely (so nothing triggers on 01/01), well ask legal to propose language that prevents auto-extension unless both parties agree in writing.

Next steps I propose:
- If 12/15 is firm, confirm and I will ask legal for an amendment reflecting a mutual 45-day notice and pro-rata credit.
- If you prefer shorter (30 days), flag it and well see if we can expedite.

Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Ben (sales) so we can move quickly.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts

Markus — thanks for the context. I reviewed the Order Form and prepared a concise set of redline recommendations. Summary below (full redline attached):

1) Notice window: propose replacing the unilateral 60-day notice with a mutual 45-day notice for pilot-era engagements. Language: "Either party may terminate the Order Form with 45 days prior written notice; no automatic renewal will occur unless both parties execute a written renewal amendment."

2) Auto-renew: remove automatic extension for pilot term; require explicit written consent to renew. This prevents inadvertent extensions.

3) Termination for convenience: allow Acme a one-time termination for convenience during pilot with pro-rata credit for prepaid but unused capacity. Redwood would retain payment for services rendered through effective termination date.

4) Offboarding: include a short offboarding schedule (key revocation, data retention/wipe options, transfer of logs) to be completed within 10 business days of effective termination.

5) Liability and revenue: limit any refund to pro-rata credits (no additional penalties). For bookkeeping, Redwood will lower outstanding invoice balance by credited amount and issue a credit memo.

Attachment: Acme-Terms-Requested-Redline.docx (redline of Order Form with bracketed alternative language).

If you want to be more customer-friendly we can offer a one-time goodwill credit (equivalent to 10% of remaining prepaid months) but I would prefer to leave that discretionary for sales ops to approve.

I can send the redline to Acme legal with a short note explaining the mutual 45-day approach. Approve and I will send.

—Olga
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acme-Terms-Requested-Redline.docx (docx)]
